b1-30-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Accents
b1-30-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks which Spanish accent is easier for you to understand: Daniela's, from Chile, or his grandmother's, from Madrid. You find Daniela's easier.
b1-30-01.prompt: Tell Carlos which accent is easier to understand.
cues: Say which one is easier to understand
b1-30-01.target: El acento de Daniela es más fácil de entender que el de la abuela de Carlos.
b1-30-01.english: Daniela's accent is easier to understand than Carlos's grandmother's.
b1-30-01.canDo: I can compare different ways of speaking.

b1-30-02.title: Communicative Challenge: My Language, My Identity
b1-30-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks whether Hungarian is part of who you are, now that you speak Spanish with her every day. You think your language is part of your identity because you speak it with your family.
b1-30-02.prompt: Tell Meg that your language is part of your identity and why.
cues: Say how language and identity are related
b1-30-02.target: Creo que mi lengua forma parte de mi identidad porque la hablo con mi familia.
b1-30-02.english: I think my language is part of my identity because I speak it with my family.
b1-30-02.canDo: I can explain the relationship between language and identity.

b1-30-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Learning About Other Cultures
b1-30-03.scenario: You are Meg. Your sister Lauren asks on a call whether it is worth learning about Hungarian customs. You think it is good to learn about other cultures and important to respect their traditions.
b1-30-03.prompt: Tell Lauren that it is good to learn about other cultures and important to respect traditions.
cues: Say it is good to learn about other cultures
Say what is important about traditions
b1-30-03.target: Es bueno que conozcamos otras culturas y es importante que respetemos las tradiciones.
b1-30-03.english: It is good that we learn about other cultures and it is important that we respect traditions.
b1-30-03.canDo: I can discuss what culture means.

b1-30-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Family Celebrations
b1-30-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how your family's celebrations compare with her family's. They are different, but both families have something in common.
b1-30-04.prompt: Tell Meg that the two celebrations are different but have something in common.
b1-30-04.target: Las fiestas de mi familia y las de tu familia son diferentes, pero tienen algo en común.
b1-30-04.english: My family's celebrations and your family's are different, but they have something in common.
b1-30-04.canDo: I can compare cultural similarities and differences.

b1-30-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Grammar for the Americas
b1-30-05.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what the text about Andrés Bello says. Bello wrote a grammar for the people of Spanish America. He wants the countries to keep a common language, but he accepts their differences.
b1-30-05.prompt: Tell Meg what Bello wrote and what he wants.
cues: Say what Bello wrote and for whom
Say what he wants the countries to keep
b1-30-05.target: Bello escribió una gramática para la gente de América. Quiere que los países mantengan una lengua común, pero acepta sus diferencias.
b1-30-05.english: Bello wrote a grammar for the Americans. He wants the countries to keep a common language, but he accepts their differences.
b1-30-05.canDo: I can discuss language, culture and identity in a sustained way.

b1-30-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Languages and Cultures
b1-30-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you think about learning a language and living between two cultures in Budapest. You think differences can be an opportunity, and that listening is as important as speaking.
b1-30-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what you think about cultural differences and about listening.
b1-30-consolidation.target: Creo que las diferencias culturales son una oportunidad para aprender. Es importante que escuchemos, y escuchar es tan importante como hablar.
b1-30-consolidation.english: I think cultural differences are an opportunity to learn. It is important that we listen, and listening is as important as speaking.
b1-30-consolidation.canDo: I can use the vocabulary of language and culture.
